modules.name: core
modules.description: SDK kernel: boots the SDK, owns the module lifecycle and gives access to modules and their status.

methods.name: boot
methods.description: Boots the SDK once: waits for the platform, signs in the guest session, loads configs and starts the eager modules. Resolves after `sdk:core:ready` is published.

returns.description: Resolves when the SDK is ready; rejects if initial authentication or a critical module fails. Auth errors retain their code, HTTP status and request id; no core-ready event is published. Boot is one-shot: destroy the failed SDK and create a new instance. Restoring a usable cached session offline still permits a successful boot.

errors.hint: Called when the SDK is not in the `created` state.
The platform did not become ready within `platformReadyTimeoutMs`.

events.name: sdk:realtime:status:changed
events.description: The realtime connection state changed. Payload: state (string).
